Repair reasons from shell/hole structure; collapsed line-only pieces can be omitted. Checks quantify area/extent changes and reject material differences.

rights: The EML names and links CC-BY-4.0 but adds share alike. The named license and contradictory text are preserved in the original XML; the concise sidecar does not assert a resolved license.
repair_acceptance: Retain all records, identifiers and attribute values. Valid decoded geometries must remain exact. Invalid polygons use make_valid(method=structure, keep_collapsed=False); reject empty/nonpolygon results, relative planar area change above 1e-8 or coordinate-bound changes above 1e-8 degrees. Area checks assess repair size, not ecological correctness.
taxon_note: Current taxon-field names are read from the fresh native geodatabase and preserve their exact Unicode spelling. Earlier inspection included misdecoded labels; those labels are not authoritative field definitions. Original matching evidence is regenerated separately from the frozen reconciliation inputs. No scientific-taxon reconciliation or catch reaggregation was performed.
field_encoding_note: The prepared field names are read directly from the native geodatabase using UTF-8, with the recorded GDAL data configuration. Earlier text-decoding errors do not justify renaming or changing the native taxon fields.

observation_coverage.note: Source EML methods report capture data from 1976–2013. No city has complete records for all years; most cities have fewer than four continuous years. These bounds describe contributing observations, not a continuous annual series.
